parts.html: The K-20 kitchen is a contemporary model for rooms that call for a fully functional work area, convenient storage, and built-in appliances within a single furniture composition. The U-shaped layout, beige laminated fronts, and understated solid-color finish create a neat interior without unnecessary visual accents.

The model’s main advantage is that the cabinets are arranged along three sides of the kitchen. This configuration allows work surfaces and storage to be distributed across several sections while maintaining convenient access to the main cooking zones.

With a length of 5.1 linear meters, the K-20 offers room for upper and lower cabinets, built-in appliances, and essential kitchen equipment. The exact placement of the sink, cooktop, and other appliances is determined when the model is adapted to the client’s room.

The beige color scheme gives the U-shaped composition a visually calm feel. The solid-color fronts can be paired with light wall finishes, wood textures, ceramic tile, and stone-effect surfaces. This approach allows the kitchen to be integrated into either a separate room or an open-plan kitchen and living area.

The upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard. Using the same material on every level of the cabinetry maintains a cohesive design. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based.

The K-20 model does not include a separate island: the main work and storage composition is formed by the U-shaped configuration itself. This makes it possible to plan the center of the room with clear walkways and easy movement between the working sides.

The standard configuration includes cabinet handles, Muller hinges without soft-close, and telescopic drawer slides without soft-close. The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Lift-up mechanisms and a cargo pull-out are not included in this model.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-20 model can be adapted to the individual dimensions of your room: the length of the cabinet runs and the placement of cabinets, the work surface, and built-in appliances can all be adjusted. The design takes into account utility connections, the room’s layout, and the client’s storage requirements.

We handle kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, we can help choose a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
